method.description: Deterministic in-repository identity reconciliation. The retained Iowa Division of Criminal Investigation packet was read page by page and each page's printed form number and caption identified, then compared against the queue row, the edition disposition and the component that binds the DCI-76 identity.
method.assignmentConstraintObserved: The stop condition confines this job to retained repository assets and deterministic identity mapping, and forbids downloading, contacting an issuer, altering legal design or editing any adopted Master Library edition. All observed.

finding.headline: DCI-76 is not a separate document. It is page 1 of a single combined Iowa Department of Public Safety packet whose remaining pages are DCI-77, and the packet is already retained. The queue's 'no repository binary' and its instruction to acquire the binary are both wrong on their face — the bytes are present and the edition already records the disposition as acquired and adopted.
finding.acquisitionRequiredRationale: There is no separate DCI-76 binary to acquire and there never was. The Department publishes one packet containing both forms, and the component resolves to that packet.
finding.defect: a component-to-document mapping recorded as an acquisition gap

oneToManyBillingRule.finding: The billing form's own face states that only one Billing Form is required when several Request Forms are submitted together.
oneToManyBillingRule.consequence: DCI-76 and DCI-77 are not a one-to-one pair. A participant submitting multiple record-check requests attaches one billing form to all of them. Any assembly that emits a billing form per request would over-produce.
oneToManyBillingRule.notDecidedHere: How a packet expresses that is a legal-design and assembly question outside this lane.

certificationOfService.finding: It established that the Iowa certification of service is a boxed section on the last page of each Rule 2.86 application rather than a standalone form.
certificationOfService.sameShape: DCI-76 is the same shape of defect in a different place: an identity recorded as a standalone acquirable document that is in fact part of a larger retained artifact. Iowa has now produced this pattern twice, which suggests the normalization pass split multi-part official packets into per-section identities.

rule2_81_2Link.finding: Iowa R. Crim. P. 2.81(2) requires a § 901C.3 expungement application to be accompanied by an official Division of Criminal Investigation Iowa criminal history record check, obtained by submitting form DCI-77 with a release authorization signature, dated within the past 30 days.
rule2_81_2Link.consequence: The DCI packet is not incidental to the Iowa expungement design — the record check it produces is a rule-mandated attachment to the misdemeanor expungement application, and the billing form is what makes the record check obtainable.
rule2_81_2Link.thirtyDayWindow: The rule's 30-day currency requirement on the record check is a real sequencing constraint on any Iowa packet. Recorded as an observation; not decided here.

doNotSubstitute.why: Pages 2 to 3 of the same packet and the other identity on the same track. It is the request form and the only approved release authorization; the billing form is not. They travel together but perform different functions and one cannot stand for the other.

doNotSubstitute.documentClass: a DCI-76 treated as a standalone document with its own edition row, receipt or field map
doNotSubstitute.why: It has no independent bytes. Creating any of those would manufacture a document the Department does not publish separately.
The DCI packet is a Department of Public Safety product, not a court form. The Rule 2.86 applications are the court-side documents and are a different issuer entirely.
The Division of Criminal Investigation packet is the statewide instrument. A county form is not it.

implementationFamilyEffect.effectOfThisJob: One Iowa identity moves from an apparent acquisition gap to a located page of a retained packet, with the packet's structure measured and its one-billing-form-per-submission rule surfaced. It is the second Iowa identity in this programme to resolve as part of a larger artifact rather than as a standalone document.
implementationFamilyEffect.familyReadinessStatement: The Iowa official-PDF family remains fail-closed and this job does not move it. No approved mapping exists, the Rule 2.86 court-side forms are themselves unmanifested and unretrieved behind an iowacourts.gov block, generation is not permitted, runtime is disabled and no field map is built.
implementationFamilyEffect.rendererObservation: A three-page unrotated Letter AcroForm with 45 terminal fields over 54 widgets, no XFA and no encryption is an acroform_fill candidate. An observation about the artifact; the lane is not assigned here.

terminalDispositionDetail.why: The narrowest disposition the evidence supports. It is not unresolved_identity: the document, issuer, title, printed form number, revision, role and page location are established. It is not acquisition_required: the packet is retained and the edition already records it as acquired and adopted. It is not a duplicate collapse either — DCI-76 and DCI-77 are genuinely different forms performing different functions, and neither should be merged into the other.

expectedDownstreamEffect: One Iowa acquisition key closes without a download, and the DCI-76 component gains a precise target — page 1 of the retained three-page Department of Public Safety packet at revision 9/22/21 — together with the packet's measured structure and both field denominators. Two self-contradictory queue fields are identified, including a retrieval instruction the row's own rationale already explains is unnecessary. The one-billing-form-per-submission rule printed on the face is surfaced so assembly does not over-produce, and the Rule 2.81(2) link is recorded, which makes the record check a rule-mandated attachment rather than an optional extra. No component is rebound, no receipt is created, no binary enters version control, no legal design is altered, no memo is edited, no edition is published, no packet becomes generatable, no runtime is enabled and no track changes promotion state.
